title: A crypto news desk that would rather say nothing than shill you
dek: GoCheckMyCrypto launches with one promise: report the real news, strip the paid promotion, and never tell you what to do with your money.
author: GoCheckMyCrypto
body: If you follow crypto, you already know the problem. Most of what arrives dressed as news is really an ad. A token you have never heard of is going to 100x by Friday. A vague partnership is announced by the only party who benefits from announcing it. A list of coins to buy turns out to be an affiliate link with a headline. It is relentless, and it is how ordinary people end up holding the bag.

GoCheckMyCrypto exists to be the opposite of that. The scarce thing in this space is not another price feed or another hot take. It is an honest voice, and the data nobody bothers to read. So that is the whole product: report what actually happened, strip out the shill, follow the money on-chain with Whale Watch, and never once tell you to buy or sell anything.
We tell you what we know, tell you how we know it, and do not pretend to know more than we do. When we are sure, we will say so plainly. When we are not, we will say that too.

Here is what that costs us. Every story is checked against the sources it cites by automated source and number checks, and a move in the market is graded only against what was reported before it. A story that cannot be stood up is held or dropped rather than softened. Crypto Cronkite is the desk's editor: the editor sets the rules those checks run by, reviews what they produce, and can hold or remove anything.

That is the point of the process, and it is written out on how we check. What we will not publish is the recipe: the tools, the wording that drives them, and the order they run in are how this desk is built rather than something you need. If keeping the standard up ever stops being sustainable, we will slow the cadence before we lower the bar. A daily that dies is worth less than a twice-a-week you can trust.

body.h2: What you can hold us to

body: We will link every source. We will mark what we could not verify. We will correct our mistakes in the open. And we will never run paid coverage as news, because paid coverage as news is the exact thing we were built to strip out.

We are not your financial advisor, and nothing here is investment advice. We will tell you what happened and, carefully, what it may mean. What you do with that is yours. That is the deal. Welcome to GoCheckMyCrypto.
human_take: The honest edge in crypto is not being first. It is being trustworthy. If we ever have to choose between the two, we choose trustworthy, every time.
corrected: 2026-10-20: the description of how stories are checked was corrected to match How we check: automated source, number and timing checks, reviewed by the editor, Crypto Cronkite. The earlier text described a different approval step.
